interpretation.chassis_response: 0x081 follows the FRC withdrawal: lateral result ID becomes 0 first, then longitudinal result ID becomes 63 (Driver Operation); request-loss remains clear.
interpretation.negative_evidence: Native 0x101 remains a non-brake frame and no sendcan 0x101 precedes the strong witness; 0x251 cruise-main availability remains asserted. This is therefore not the normal brake/button cancel path and not loss-of-request supervision.
